Now, that woman tarnishes the very name Mandalorian. Defend her, if you will.|Pre Vizsla denounces Satine Kryze in front of Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=AgainstTheJedi-TMP.flac|}} A '''fight''' took place in early [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was ambushed by warriors of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a splinter group of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] society. Kenobi was escorting the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], on a diplomatic mission to Mandalore's moon [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]] to confer with the local [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]. The Duchess was unaware of Vizsla's position as the [[Secret Mandalore|Overlord]] of the local Death Watch. Vizsla had been conspiring with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who had been backing the Death Watch in an attempt to destabilize the pacifist government of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]. Kenobi was ambushed by Vizsla's men at a [[Concordian mines/Legends|mining facility]] used by the Death Watch as a base. The Duchess came to his assistance, and this culminated in a large firefight which left several Mandalorian warriors dead or wounded. As the fighting continued, Governor Vizsla went public with his position as the leader of the Death Watch and confronted Kenobi using his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian battle armor]] and a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] known as the [[Darksaber/Legends|Darksaber]]. Kenobi was forced to flee after Vizsla ordered his men to intervene in the duel, although he successfully extracted the Duchess back to Mandalore, where they departed to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on Satine's personal ship, the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']]. ==Prelude== ===Mandalore's proposed neutrality=== {{Quote|Mandalore would never turn against the Republic. The Duchess Satine values peace more than her own life.|[[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]]|audio=SatineValuesPeace-TMP.flac|}} [[File:New_Mandalorians.png|thumb|left|220px|Duchess Satine Kryze, leader of the New Mandalorians during the Clone Wars]] In approximately [[738 BBY]], a conflict broke out between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] that brought devastation to the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. While many of the warrior clans scattered, out of the ashes rose the [[New Mandalorians|New Mandalorian]] faction. Doing away with many of the [[Canons of Honor|old warrior codes]] the Mandalorians had historically followed, the New Mandalorians put forward the idea that the best opportunity for Mandalorian survival and prosperity would come through being peaceful, neutral, and tolerant.''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' This movement, led by [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], based its values on pacifism and nonviolence. Kryze was installed as the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of the new government, and a man named [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] was named the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]]. Under their rule, those within their society who refused to yield to these reforms were banished to Mandalore's moon, [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. Following the start of the Clone Wars during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Kryze formed the [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|Council of Neutral Systems]], an alliance of at least 1,500 star systems who wished to remain neutral in the war. The [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Concordia, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], in the meantime, rallied the surviving members of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a Mandalorian splinter group based on brutal violence and dishonorable actions. In contrast to the honorable [[True Mandalorians]] and New Mandalorians, the Death Watch expressed its distaste at Kryze's rule over Mandalore by vandalizing public places and committing terrorist acts. When the Clone Wars began, the group received support from [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Dooku encouraged Vizsla to give the Galactic Republic a reason to send a military presence to Mandalore, which would cause the citizens of Mandalore to rebel with the support of Death Watch. Taking Dooku's advice, Vizsla sent a lone [[Unidentified Death Watch saboteur/Legends|Death Watch saboteur]] to attack a Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. The saboteur was subdued by the Republic forces on board the ship. However, unwilling to submit to interrogation, the man [[Death/Legends|took his own life]]. In response to the incident, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent to Mandalore by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] on a diplomatic mission to reconfirm Kryze's neutral stance. Kryze and Almec assured Kenobi that no member of the New Mandalorian faction would ever take up arms against the Republic. Kryze suspected that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was trying to intervene in Mandalorian affairs, despite the fact that the investigation was under orders of the Jedi Council. ===Diplomacy to Concordia=== {{Quote|Duchess Satine, you are most welcome.''"
"''Thank you, Governor Vizsla. May I present Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, representing the Jedi Council. Governor Vizsla is one of the officials I spoke of. He has been working to find the members of the Death Watch.|Introductions are made on Concordia|audio=ConcordiaIntroductions-TMP.flac|}} [[File:Vizsla_welcomes_Satine.png|thumb|right|220px|Governor Vizsla welcomes Kenobi and the Duchess to Concordia]] A [[Death Watch bomber/Legends|loyal member of Death Watch]] armed a bomb in the [[Memorial Shrine/Legends|Memorial Shrine]] in the capital city of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], which [[Attack on the Memorial Shrine/Legends|detonated]] while Kenobi and Kryze were strolling through the area. Kryze coincidentally revealed to Kenobi her growing concern of the recent resurgence of the Death Watch group, which she believed was just a group of "hooligans" who vandalized public places, moments before the explosion. Upon finding the mark of the Death Watch at the site, Kenobi assured Kryze that the Death Watch was more than a mere group of hooligans and that the terrorist bombing was a demonstration against her government. Kenobi ordered the area be locked down, with no one allowed to leave without being questioned. The bomber, hiding in the crowd, fled the scene out of fear. Kenobi gave chase on foot, which eventually led to a dead-end platform. The bomber opened fire on Kenobi with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]]. Kenobi deflected the shots and disarmed the bomber, but was unable to prevent the bomber from jumping off the platform to his death. With his dying breath, the bomber told the Duchess his loyalty to Death Watch, in a [[Concordian/Legends|dialect]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] used on Concordia, confirming the Duchess's suspicions that the group was based on Mandalore's moon. Kenobi and the Duchess arranged a meeting with Pre Vizsla, the governor of Concordia and secretly the leader of the Death Watch. While the Duchess occupied Vizsla during dinner, Kenobi left to investigate a local mining facility that was believed abandoned. ==The skirmish== ===Mining facility=== {{Quote|Start the machine. Time for the Jedi to meet with his fatal accident.|Death Watch warrior|audio=FatalAccident-TMP.flac|}} Upon Kenobi's arrival at a local mining facility, which was in reality a Death Watch stronghold, Kenobi concluded that the facility was still operational. Upon further inspection, Kenobi found a rack of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] and an accompanying rack of Mandalorian helmets. A Death Watch member, using Kenobi's curiosity with the helmet to his advantage, ambushed the Jedi from behind and opened fire with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Kenobi's reflexes allowed him to block the incoming shots with the Mandalorian helmet, but the Mandalorian quickly lunged at Kenobi, knocking him to the floor. As Kenobi got to his feet and brandished his blue [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the warrior seemingly disappeared. [[File:ObiWan_strung_up.png|thumb|left|230px|Kenobi captured by Death Watch]] Kenobi assured to the Death Watch his protection under Duchess Satine of Mandalore. Another Death Watch member denounced Kenobi and Satine, asserting that the Death Watch did not recognize Satine's rule. The warrior lunged at Kenobi over a conveyor belt, firing two shots at the Jedi. Kenobi deflected the two shots with his lightsaber, and countered the Mandalorian with a kick, but the warrior fired a third shot at the Jedi which disarmed him. Kenobi quickly grabbed the Mandalorian and threw several punches at the warrior's face. However, the other Mandalorian reappeared and grabbed Kenobi's right arm, allowing both warriors to land a punch on Kenobi simultaneously, knocking him to the floor. As Kenobi attempted to regain himself, he was incapacitated by a kick to the face. The two Death Watch stole Kenobi's lightsaber and hooked him to a rock-crushing machine. Under Pre Vizsla's orders, the two surveyed the area for signs of other Jedi. Kenobi regained consciousness as the two left and contacted Satine, who at the time was having a dinner conversation with Pre Vizsla about the current political atmosphere surrounding Mandalore's neutrality. Satine left the dinner table under the guise of a sudden feeling of sickness, and used a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] to travel to the mining facility, utilizing a tracker in her comlink to find her way. The two Death Watch activated the rock crusher, hoping to make Kenobi's death look like a fatal accident. However, they were distracted by a false alarm triggered by Satine, and left the room to investigate. In their absence, Satine deactivated the rock crusher before it killed Kenobi. The two Death Watch members returned to the machine and restrained Satine, who kicked a metal canister into the rock crusher's gears, allowing Kenobi to detach himself. Kenobi used the metal canister to launch himself to the ceiling, using the ceiling to launch himself into a spring kick, incapacitating the Mandalorian restraining Satine. As the other Mandalorian attacked Kenobi, Kenobi grabbed him and threw him into the wall, incapacitating him as well. Kenobi and Satine escaped the mining facility in an elevator. ===Firefight=== {{Quote|We'll have to stand and fight. Or in your case, just stand.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Duchess Satine|audio=StandAndFight-TMP.flac|}} [[File:Satine_TMP.png|thumb|right|250px|Satine saves Obi-Wan in the mining facility.]] As the elevator reached its destination at the surface of the planet, Kenobi quickly knocked out a Death Watch member guarding the elevator door with two swift punches to the head. A squad of Mandalorians nearby witnessed this and opened fire, causing the elevator to detach and fall. Kenobi realized that his lightsaber had been stolen, and uncharacteristically instead utilized the blaster weapon of the Mandalorian he incapacitated. As three Death Watch members flew towards Satine and Kenobi using their jetpacks, Kenobi landed a shot on one of them. As the two remaining Mandalorians approached, Kenobi used the unconscious Mandalorian's jetpack as an improvised explosive. He threw the jetpack at the two Mandalorians and landed a blaster shot on it, causing the jetpack to explode, taking out one of the Mandalorians. However, the other survived the blast and lunged at Kenobi. As he approached Kenobi for the kill, Satine distracted the Death Watch member by throwing a rock at his head, giving Kenobi a few seconds to sweep the Mandalorian off his feet and knock him out with a kick to the stomach. ===Duel with Pre Vizsla=== {{Quote|This lightsaber was stolen from the Jedi Temple by my ancestors during the fall of the Old Republic. Since then, many Jedi have died upon its blade. Prepare yourself to join them.|Pre Vizsla|audio=Darksaber-TMP.flac|}} [[File:PreVizslaDeathWatch-TheMandalorePlot.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Vizsla and three warriors approach Kenobi and Duchess Satine]] As Vizsla monitored his men losing the battle to the Jedi, Vizsla ordered the rest of his men to retreat while he personally confronted Kenobi. Flanked by three of his Death Watch warriors, Vizsla displayed his ruthlessness by executing the Mandalorian who Kenobi had just knocked out with a single blaster shot. He then exposed his true identity to Kenobi and Kryze, explaining his bitter feelings towards the Duchess and the New Mandalorian culture. Vizsla returned Kenobi's lightsaber, asking Kenobi to defend the Duchess in an honorable duel. Vizsla's weapon of choice for the battle was a unique black lightsaber known as the [[Darksaber/Legends|Darksaber]], which was passed down to Vizsla after it was stolen from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the fall of the Old Republic. Kenobi managed to disarm Vizsla, but Vizsla quickly countered and knocked Kenobi off his feet, giving him time to recover his weapon. Vizsla activated his jetpack and attempted to execute Kenobi with a jetpack-enhanced jump, but Kenobi gathered himself off the floor and grabbed Vizsla, throwing him to the ground. Vizsla realized that Kenobi had the upper hand in the duel, and ordered his Death Watch warriors to finish him off. The three warriors fired their jetpack-mounted rockets in unison, which initially missed Kenobi. However, when the rockets looped back around to track Kenobi, Kenobi was forced to escape with Satine down an elevator shaft. Vizsla ordered the warriors to not pursue. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|You sound tired.''"
"''The peaceful ways of the locals wore me out a bit.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=WoreMeOut-TMP.flac|}} Kenobi escorted the Duchess back to Sundari on Mandalore, meeting with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]. They were assigned to escort the Duchess to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], in order for her to assert her neutral views on the war to the Galactic Senate. However, the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] representing Mandalore, [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]], was secretly in league with the Death Watch and smuggled crates of [[Assassin probe/Legends|assassin probes]] into the cargo hold of the ship, resulting in a number of assassination attempts on the Duchess en route to Coruscant. ==Behind the scenes== Obi-Wan Kenobi's battle with the Death Watch on Concordia was first featured in a season-two episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', "[[The Mandalore Plot]]." During the climactic duel between Kenobi and Vizsla, Vizsla was originally to use a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. However, [[George Lucas]] decided that only a lightsaber could stand against a lightsaber, and with that in mind, helped the show's crew conceive the idea for the Darksaber.{{WebCite|url=http://tv.ign.com/articles/106/1063990p1.html|text=Star Wars: Are You Ready for the Mandalorians?|archivedate=20100131080603}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}} {{Flash}} *{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}} {{Flash}} *''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'' {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode212.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Mandalore Plot}} *''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Mission von Concordia |es=Escaramuza en Concordia |pl=Potyczka na Concordii }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Concordia, fight on}} [[Category:Battles of Concordia]] [[Category:Events during the Clone Wars]] [[Category:Lightsaber duels]]
